About the Role

We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).

This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.

However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
  • Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
  • Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
  • Refactor and update existing themes and templates
  • Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
  • Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)

 

Work Hours & Meetings

You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)

Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.

You have:

  1. At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
  2. Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
  3. Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
  4. Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
  5. The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
  6. The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity

  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits

  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Interview Process

  1. Take-home assignment submission (as described above).

  2. Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style).

  3. 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership.

How to apply

Email your portfolio, GitHub repository, and as an optional bonus, 1-2 other relevant projects to techjobs@fluencetraining.com, along with a short note on a security/privacy consideration you implemented (or would implement) in a healthcare or similar context.

jobs.description_html:
Overview

PR kann heute mehr, als nur Sichtbarkeit verwalten.

Bei getpress bauen wir an einer Marke, die zeigt, wie moderne Kommunikation für Europas ambitionierteste Unternehmen aussehen kann: strategisch, messbar, relevant und mit einem klaren Gefühl für Qualität.
Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere externe Kommunikation ownt und vor allem sichtbar macht. Jemanden, der*die starke Themen erkennt, gute Formate daraus entwickelt und sie auch selbst umsetzt – von LinkedIn und Website über Podcast, Blog und Whitepaper bis zu Speaker- und Event-Content.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content, Thought Leadership und externer Kommunikation. Dabei bist du strategisch genug, um Themen, Kanäle und Formate kritisch zu hinterfragen und hands-on genug, um auch selbst zu schreiben, zu produzieren, zu redigieren und Dinge live zu bringen.

  • Du planst, steuerst und produzierst unseren Content für alle relevanten Kanäle und Formate – darunter LinkedIn, Website, Blog, Podcast, Whitepaper sowie Speaker-Auftritte und Events.
  • Du schreibst, redigierst und schärfst Inhalte selbst – von LinkedIn-Posts und Website-Texten über Case Studies und Blogartikel bis zu Podcast-Beschreibungen, Speaker-Profilen und Präsentationsinhalten.
  • Du denkst Visuals, Präsentationen, Social Assets und einfache Foto-/Video-Formate mit und kannst kleinere Content-Produktionen selbst umsetzen oder sauber briefen.
  • Du sparrst mit unseren Corporate Creator*innen und dem C-Level zu Personal Brands, Thought Leadership, Themen, Tonalität und Formatideen.
  • Du betreust unseren Podcast redaktionell von Gäste-Recherche und Briefings bis zur Veröffentlichung und begleitenden Kommunikation.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass getpress über alle Touchpoints hinweg konsistent, hochwertig und markant auftritt, in Sprache, Look, Dramaturgie und Qualität.
  • Du beobachtest, wie unsere Inhalte performen, leitest daraus Learnings ab und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Formate, Kanäle und Botschaften weiterentwickeln.
  • Du repräsentierst getpress auch nach außen – auf Events, in Netzwerken und an den Stellen, an denen Marke durch echten Kontakt entsteht.

Wer du bist

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Kommunikation, Brand, Content oder PR, idealerweise im B2B-Umfeld und in einer Agentur oder einem dienstleistungsnahen Kontext.

Außerdem macht dich folgendes aus:

  • Ein feines Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und Qualität. Du erkennst schnell, wann ein Text, Auftritt oder Format wirklich sitzt.
  • Du denkst strategisch mit, verlierst dich aber nicht in Konzepten. Dein Ziel ist Sichtbarkeit schaffen.
  • Du hast LinkedIn, Organic Social und Personal Branding vollständig durchdrungen und weißt, wie man echte Markenwirkung erzeugt.
  • Du kannst Themen priorisieren, Kommunikationsmaßnahmen einschätzen und Redaktionspläne eigenständig strukturieren.
  • Ein gutes Auge für Design, Ästhetik und Brand Consistency, auch bei Slides, Social Assets, Website-Elementen und Event-Content.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Canva und hast keine Berührungsängste mit Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Lightroom oder einfachen Editing-Workflows.
  • Du bringst Foto- und Video-Basics mit oder hast Lust, dich in einfache Inhouse-Content-Produktion einzuarbeiten.
  • Du arbeitest souverän mit KI-Tools und nutzt sie für bessere Recherche, Briefings, Struktur, Workflows, Varianten und Qualität, nicht als Abkürzung für generischen Content.
  • Du hast eine eigene Meinung, gibst klares Feedback und bringst dich im Sparring mit Team und C-Level aktiv ein, statt Aufträge nur abzuarbeiten.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du bist bei uns die einzige Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest Brand und Content ohne Doppelstrukturen, mit direktem Draht zum C-Level.
  • Eine Rolle, in der du strategisch gestaltest und selbst umsetzt, und direkt siehst, welche Wirkung deine Arbeit hat.
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Kommunikation als echter Faktor für Sichtbarkeit, Vertrauen und Relevanz gesehen wird.
  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Formate und Arbeitsweisen auszuprobieren – besonders an der Schnittstelle von Brand, Content und AI.
  • Ein Team, das ambitioniert, warm und beweglich ist und richtig Bock hat, Dinge voranzubringen.
  • Du wirst regelmäßig vor Ort in Berlin gebraucht – für Abstimmungen, Content-Produktion, Events und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Stakeholdern. Gleichzeitig kannst du auch remote arbeiten. Wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, klarer Kommunikation und Vertrauen.
  • Gehalt: 60.000–70.000 € brutto jährlich

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn sich das nach deinem nächsten Schritt anfühlt, dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil, relevante Arbeitsproben oder ein Portfolio.

Uns interessiert nicht nur, was du gemacht hast. Sondern vor allem auch, wie du denkst, wie du Qualität einschätzt und welches Gefühl du für starke Kommunikation mitbringst.

jobs.description_html:
Hey, wir sind Junto! 😊

Wir machen Leadership Development für das KI-Zeitalter: Wir befähigen Führungskräfte, KI in ihren Teams wirksam einzusetzen, und begleiten Unternehmen wie AOK PLUS, Henkel, Ottobock und diva-e mit blended Lernreisen. Seit 2022 haben wir mit über 100 Kunden gearbeitet und mehr als 2.000 Führungskräfte begleitet. Mit der HHL Executive Education bieten wir zudem ein offenes Zertifikatsprogramm zur KI-Transformation an.

Wir sind eigenfinanziert, profitabel und bewusst ein kleines, KI-gestütztes Team. Wir arbeiten selbst jeden Tag mit Claude, Agenten und Automatisierungen: Unsere eigene KI-Transformation ist unser bester Use Case.

Für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt suchen wir dich als Senior Consultant AI Enablement: die Person, die KI-Expertise und Beratungsdenke in unsere Programme bringt.

Aufgaben

Deine Verantwortung

  • Du konzipierst maßgeschneiderte KI-Befähigungsprogramme für Führungskräfte unserer Kund:innen vom Vorstand bis zur Teamleitung, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Leadership Development

  • Du arbeitest mit unserem Gründer und Geschäftsführer am Business Development und an Pitches für potenzielle Neukunden

  • Du setzt eigene, kleine Use Cases für unsere interne KI-Transformation um und testest dabei fortlaufend neue KI-Tools und Anwendungsmöglichkeiten

Deine Aufgaben

  • Discovery: Du analysierst Bedarfe und KI-Reifegrad der Zielgruppe (Interviews, Surveys, Use-Case-Workshops)

  • Design: Du entwickelst Inhalte, Übungen, Demos und Arbeitsmaterialien, z. B. Präsentationen mit Speaker Notes, Prompt-Bibliotheken, Hands-on-Labs

  • Delivery: Du moderierst Sessions und Workshops selbst (online und vor Ort) und/oder begleitest unsere Executive Trainer:innen

  • Use Cases und Prozesse: Du identifizierst mit Fachbereichen konkrete KI-Use-Cases, priorisierst sie und übersetzt sie in Prozesse

  • Iteration: Du wertest Feedback und Daten aus und entwickelst unsere Programme weiter

Deine Schnittstellen

  • Intern: Du arbeitest direkt mit Marius (Gründer und Geschäftsführer) und Andreas (Head of Leadership Development) sowie unserem Learning-Design-Team zusammen

  • Extern: Du führst Kundenbeziehungen von der Personalvorständin bis zum L&D-Experten und arbeitest mit Top-Coaches aus unserem Netzwerk (z. B. CMO bei T-Systems, Head of AI bei Mercedes)

Qualifikation

Erfahrung

  • Du bringst 3 bis 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit, idealerweise aus der Unternehmensberatung oder aus Transformations- und Change-Projekten

  • KI-Erfahrung: Du hast selbst schon kleinere Automatisierungen oder Agenten eingesetzt und in KI-Transformations- oder Enablement-Projekten mitgewirkt

  • Erfahrung in Learning Design oder Leadership Development ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Das didaktische Know-how bringen wir mit

Eigene KI-Kompetenz

  • Du nutzt KI täglich und deine Begeisterung für die Potenziale ist ansteckend

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit fortgeschrittenen KI-Tools gesammelt, z. B. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Microsoft Copilot Studio oder Agenten in Microsoft Foundry

  • Du erklärst Konzepte wie Agenten, Automatisierung oder KI-Governance so, dass auch nicht-technische Führungskräfte sie verstehen und für sich nutzen können

  • Wenn du etwas noch nicht weißt, weißt du, wie du es dir mit KI beibringen kannst

Mindset und Arbeitsweise

  • Human-first: Du kombinierst deine Begeisterung für KI-Technologie mit Verständnis für menschenzentrierten Change und einer klaren Business-Denke (Workflows, Use Cases)

  • Präsentationsstark: Du stehst gern vor Gruppen, von der Teamleitung bis zum Top-Management

  • Neugier: Du bleibst bei KI-Entwicklungen dran und teilst dein Wissen gern

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, steile Lernkurve: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer und Geschäftsführer und dem Head of Leadership Development zusammen

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst unser KI-Angebot an der Schnittstelle von KI und Führung mit und kannst in einem stark wachsenden Feld schnell Verantwortung übernehmen

  • KI-Setup: Du bekommst Zugang zu modernen KI-Tools und Zeit zum Experimentieren

  • Vergütung: 70.000 bis 85.000 € pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest remote in der DACH-Region, gelegentlich bei Kund:innen vor Ort und bei Team-Treffen (unser Offsite im Dezember ist auf Mallorca ☀️)

  • Urban Sports Club und Co. gibt's natürlich auch ;-)

So sieht der weitere Prozess aus

  1. Kennenlerngespräch mit Asif (ca. 30 Min.)

  2. Fachliches Gespräch mit Marius (ca. 45 Min.)

  3. Case mit Andreas und Marius (ca. 60 Min. plus 2-3h Vorbereitung)

  4. Vertragsangebot 🚀

Wenn du dir unsicher bist, ob es passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! 😊

jobs.description_html:
Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Hauptverwaltung Düsseldorf · Direkt an die Geschäftsführung angebunden · Start kurzfristig, spätestens zum 01.01.2027

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Stell dir vor

Montagmorgen. Eine Standortleitung braucht bis Mitte des Monats eine neue Dozentin, also geht die Anzeige heute noch raus. Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Du sortierst, legst los – und am Abend ist alles erledigt und sauber in Personio dokumentiert.

Das ist kein Werbetext. Das ist der Job. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personalarbeit nicht delegiert, sondern macht: von der Stellenanzeige bis zum Zeugnis, selbstständig und mit Tempo.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg und Berlin sowie in Marokko. Wir konzipieren und realisieren geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprachkurse und Weiterbildungen – für Privat- wie Firmenkunden, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Worum es geht

Wir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. Dafür brauchen wir kurzfristig eine Person, die unsere Personalarbeit operativ in die Hand nimmt: das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung, schnelles Recruiting und eine Personalabteilung, die vollständig über Personio läuft.

Du arbeitest sehr eigenständig, verantwortest die operative Personalarbeit ab Januar in eigener Hand und hast den direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Wenn du gern selbst anpackst, statt Zuständigkeiten zu verteilen, bist du hier richtig.

Was du bewegst

  • Personalabteilung über Personio führen – Du führst unsere Personalarbeit in Personio: Stammdaten, digitale Personalakte, Abwesenheiten, Dokumente, Workflows und Auswertungen. Was noch nicht sauber läuft, richtest du ein.
  • Personalsachbearbeitung von A bis Z – Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und Schreiben erstellst du selbst. Du pflegst die Personalakten und behältst Fristen wie Probezeiten und Befristungen im Blick.
  • Kurzfristig einstellen – Du schreibst Stellen aus, sichtest Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche, stimmst Termine ab und bringst Einstellungen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift – auch wenn es schnell gehen muss.
  • On- und Offboarding – Du begleitest Eintritte und Austritte vollständig: Unterlagen, Unterweisungen, Zugänge, Übergaben.
  • Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung – Du bereitest die monatlichen Lohndaten vor, klärst Rückfragen und hältst den Kontakt zur Steuerberatung.
  • Ansprechperson im Alltag – Du bist erste Adresse für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei allen Personalfragen und bereitest arbeitsrechtliche Vorgänge wie Abmahnungen oder Kündigungen sauber vor.
  • Mitdenken und anpacken – Du kümmerst dich um das, was anfällt – auch wenn es nicht in der Stellenbeschreibung steht.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zur Personalkauffrau bzw. zum Personalkaufmann, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.
  • Erfahrung – Mehrjährige Praxis in der operativen Personalarbeit. Du beherrschst das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung und hast es selbst gemacht, nicht nur begleitet.
  • Personio – Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio und hast das System idealerweise selbst eingerichtet oder administriert.
  • Arbeitsrecht – Solide Grundkenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht für das Tagesgeschäft – und das Gespür dafür, wann du dir Rat holst.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität – Du packst an, kümmerst dich und arbeitest gern selbstständig. Du priorisierst sicher, wenn vieles gleichzeitig kommt.
  • Verfügbarkeit – Du kannst kurzfristig einsteigen, bestenfalls zum 01.01.2027 oder früher.
  • Persönlichkeit – Verbindlichkeit, strukturierter Arbeitsstil, klare Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift und absolute Diskretion.
  • Von Vorteil – Erfahrung bei einem Bildungsträger oder im SGB-II/III-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Was du bei uns findest

  • Eigenverantwortung – Du baust die Personalarbeit so auf, wie sie gut funktioniert – mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Wirkung – Deine Arbeit betrifft unmittelbar unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Führungskräfte und die Entwicklung der gesamten Gruppe.
  • Ein Team mit echter Diversity – Auf Augenhöhe, mehrsprachig und mit Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.
  • Entwicklung – Gezielte Förderung deiner Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung.
  • Sicherheit – Festanstellung bei einem Bildungsträger, der seit über 15 Jahren im Markt ist.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) mit Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Eintrittstermin an Herrn Debdoubi

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei einer der operativen Tochtergesellschaften der EuBiA-Gruppe – EuBiA GmbH, EuBiA Rhein-Ruhr-West GmbH oder EuBiA NRW GmbH – je nach Aufgabengebiet.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.description_html:
SumUp is preparing to build a CRR (Capital Requirements Regulation) licensed bank in Germany—an important next chapter in our journey to help small businesses thrive. As Managing Director, Front Office, you'll be part of the team that shapes how this bank serves customers: the proposition we bring to market, the products we build, and the standards by which we grow.

This is a rare opportunity to take an executive management role in a new, digitally native bank. You'll combine commercial leadership with direct accountability for customer-facing governance, and represent the market perspective in dialogue with supervisors. We're looking for a leader who sees customer trust and sustainable growth as inseparable—and who can build with the pace of a technology company and the discipline of a bank.

What you'll do

  • Together with the other members of the executive management team contribute to the strategic and corporate development of the bank.
  • Lead the market facing part for the German banking licence application. Represent the bank in supervisory dialogue on commercial strategy, products, distribution and customer treatment, including with BaFin, Deutsche Bundesbank and the European Central Bank where relevant.
  • Support building  the go to market operating model and ensure it is integrated into the bank's governance, risk and control framework. Work closely with the Managing Director, Back Office (Geschäftsleiter Marktfolge) to ensure product, conduct and outsourcing risks are understood and managed.
  • Partner with the wider SumUp and bank leadership teams—including Finance, Global Banking, Product and Engineering—to turn the strategy into a viable, well-governed business.
  • Coach the next generation of SumUp leaders on their path to a §25c Abs 1 KWG qualification.

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You bring 15 - 20+ years of senior leadership experience in credit institutions, including the qualification according to §25c Abs. 1 KWG.
  • You have led commercial, product or customer activity in a regulated bank and can show how you balanced business performance with customer outcomes, conduct requirements and effective controls.
  • You have a practical understanding of German and European banking regulation, including the requirements relevant to governance, product oversight, market conduct and customer protection.
  • You're fluent in German and have excellent English skills. You can engage credibly with supervisors, communicate complex issues clearly and raise difficult topics early.
  • You bring sound judgement, integrity and the independence of mind expected of a bank executive, and can meet the applicable fitness and propriety requirements for the appointment.
  • You're comfortable building in a fast-moving environment where there may be limited precedent. You can establish the right foundations without slowing the business down with unnecessary processes.
  • Experience in merchant or SME banking, payments, lending, embedded finance, digital banking or API-led products would be especially valuable. So would experience building a new regulated entity or scaling a fintech, specialist lender or digital bank. 
  • You'll need to commit the capacity expected of a full-time executive board role.

Why you should join SumUp

  • You'll help shape a new bank for the businesses that keep local economies moving. 
  • You'll have the influence to define its commercial direction and customer proposition, while building the governance and trust that let it grow for the long term. 
  • It's a chance to bring together your banking experience and your builder mindset at a defining moment for SumUp.

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. jobs.description_html:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a Deployment Associate to join our deployment team, keep customer implementations organized and on-track, and support Deployment Leads transitioning finance teams onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who has the structure and follow-through to run the details of a complex project, and who wants to learn ERP implementation and AI native accounting from the people who lead it. You may come from an implementation or consulting firm, a Big 4 advisory or audit practice, a finance or operations team at a SaaS company, or a project coordination role in a technical environment. You will work alongside Deployment Leads, who own solutioning and the design decisions behind each implementation, and you will take on the project management, coordination, and hands-on support that get every launch over the line.

You will combine strong organizational instincts with curiosity and a customer-first mindset, tracking details, flagging risks early, and learning how configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live fit together. This role is a clear path to Deployment Lead: as you build experience, you take on more solutioning and begin leading deployments of your own.

We're primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we're also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Assist customer implementations with AI at the center: use Rillet's AI tools and agents to handle the work that used to be manual, including project plans, status updates, call recaps, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment and customers

  • Bring accounting and human judgment to AI-driven data migration:

    • Map legacy charts of accounts, dimensions, and entity structures from legacy ERPs into Rillet

    • Migrate historical financials by preparing and validating opening balances, historical trial balances, and journal entry loads, and tying them out to the customer’s prior books

    • Configure revenue recognition under ASC 606: turn customer contracts into products, performance obligations, and revenue schedules, and check deferred and recognized revenue against the customer’s existing waterfall

    • Build go-live reconciliations: tie AR, AP, bank, deferred revenue, and other subledgers to the GL in audit-ready workpapers, with review from a Deployment Lead

  • Improve the tools as you use them: spot where an AI workflow falls short, refine prompts and skills, and build new automations and agents on Rillet's API that make the next deployment faster

  • Test configuration, integrations, and system settings with AI-assisted checks, and document what you find so the whole team can reuse it

  • Be a responsive, trusted point of contact for customers during onboarding, using AI to get them answers faster and routing the rest to the right teammate

  • Learn from Deployment Leads by shadowing discovery, solutioning, and go-live sessions, and see how they turn complex accounting requirements into practical solutions

  • Help shape our deployment strategy: stay on top of trends in fintech, AI, and accounting, test new approaches on live implementations, and bring recommendations to Deployment Leads and leadership

  • Capture what works across deployments as playbooks, templates, and shared workflows the team can use on every launch

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to turn customer feedback and AI findings into product improvements

  • Identify risks and blockers early and escalate them before they affect the timeline, and take on larger workstreams over time as you grow toward Deployment Lead

Who We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years in ERP implementation, accounting, audit, systems consulting, finance transformation, or project coordination (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is a plus

  • Exposure to ERP systems (NetSuite, Oracle, Sage, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, or go-live; leading these end to end is not expected

  • Working understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and curiosity about how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication skills and the judgment to grow into stakeholder management

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to keep multiple workstreams organized

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

Compensation

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Search & Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform’s two-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.

Shape and Drive Two-Sided Marketplace Strategy

  • Dual-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
  • Resource & ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Market & Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.

Executive Influence & Stakeholder Alignment

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Mexico City, Mexico

What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer Manager

As a SE Manager for Cloudflare for the LATAM Markets you will be responsible for managing a cross functional, full sales life cycle and technical activities for Cloudflare customers. The role requires someone with strong leadership, interpersonal, and business acumen to work with Sales to grow our account base. The SE Manager will manage a team of SEs that are geographically distributed within the US and Mexico, covering all of the countries that make up LATAM for Cloudflare. The SE team partners with the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Public Sector LATAM Sales teams that are also geographically distributed in the US and Mexico, as well as Customer Success and is responsible for providing the value of Cloudflare products to customers and prospects

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, experience and goals

Our Solutions Engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds: financial consulting, engineering, software development, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.

Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and people, and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems or another related field or its equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience with internet technologies / protocols and / or cloud technologies
  • Minimum 1 year of team lead/team management experience
  • Experience managing opportunity sales cycles and identifying technical proof activities
  • Demonstrated operations and organization skills implementation and driving best practices with cross functional organizations.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills with a proven track record of successfully building collaboration around important initiatives.
  • Successful track record of working and influencing matrixed organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively present technical and business related subjects to all audiences.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills, drive for results, interpersonal savvy, and customer focus.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Headquarters: Remote, United States

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Director, Technical Architects on GitLab's AMER Professional Services team, you oversee one of the most technically credible and customer-facing groups in the organization. This team helps turn customer priorities into real adoption and measurable outcomes by guiding complex implementations, shaping new service patterns, and bringing emerging GitLab capabilities into production environments.

You'll own the Global Technical Architecture practice across both presales and delivery, managing a team of AMER Technical Architects who work on complex customer needs, early-stage offerings, and strategic engagements. This role is well suited for someone who can coach senior technical talent, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep the team focused on customer outcomes instead of task completion.

In your first year, you'll focus on stabilizing and growing the team, tightening the link between presales scoping and delivery, and turning field work into repeatable offerings. You'll work alongside architects in areas including AI, security, and broader platform architecture, while helping the team turn what they learn in the field into repeatable methods that can scale across Professional Services.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Running technical discovery, scoping, and delivery for complex Professional Services engagements in AMER
  • Turning early customer work on new GitLab capabilities into repeatable delivery kits, standards, and service patterns

What you’ll do

  • Hire, manage, and develop a growing AMER Technical Architecture team, including Intermediate, Senior, and Staff Technical Architects working across platform, AI, and security-related customer engagements.
  • Lead the global Technical Architecture practice, aligning architects in AMER, EMEA, and APJ on shared standards for scoping, statement of work review, service offerings and delivery leadership.
  • Manage the practice end to end, covering presales collaboration, engagement scoping, technical delivery oversight, staffing, utilization, and forecast alignment, with accountability for improving utilization, delivery quality, and forecast accuracy.
  • Coach architects to grow from hands-on implementers into technical leaders and credible advisors on most of their engagements, with a focus on customer outcomes, strong technical judgment, and consultative communication.
  • Partner on complex presales motions with Engagement Managers on estimation, solution framing, technical objection handling, statement of work assumptions, and technical risk to build customer confidence, improve scoping accuracy, and strengthen delivery readiness.
  • Join strategic customer conversations where senior technical expertise helps build credibility, clarify ambiguity, and improve the path to successful delivery.
  • Guide the team through first-mover delivery of new GitLab capabilities, helping shape how emerging offerings are tested, delivered, and improved in real customer environments to shorten time to production and increase successful adoption.
  • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable templates, architecture guidance, migration patterns, and implementation standards that increase reuse and improve delivery consistency across the broader Professional Services organization.
  • Represent the Technical Architecture practice in AMER Professional Services management discussions and partner with adjacent functions to improve coordination, service evolution, and delivery consistency.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience managing senior technical professionals in a services, consulting, or Professional Services environment, with a strong track record of coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Working knowledge of GitLab, software development, site reliability and infrastructure engineering, security, cloud architecture, and agile delivery, with enough depth to guide technical direction and build credibility with highly experienced architects.
  • Experience running consultative engagements by linking technical work to business goals and keeping teams focused on customer value and realized outcomes.
  • Experience with technically complex presales work, including discovery, scoping, estimation, solution definition, and risk assessment.
  • Experience running a billable team against utilization targets, with a clear grasp of how utilization, margin, and forecast accuracy drive Professional Services revenue.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments where offerings, priorities, and organizational needs continue to evolve.
  • Experience building or improving repeatable delivery methods such as playbooks, standards, service kits, architecture patterns, or implementation guidance.
  • A servant-leadership style built on empathy and continuous improvement: you remove blockers for your team, act on what retrospectives surface, and build processes that make it easy to do the right thing.
  • Experience leading customer conversations at every level, from platform engineers to the CTO, giving clear feedback, and aligning cross-functional stakeholders around delivery direction.
  • Familiarity with GitLab-relevant domains such as AI-powered developer workflows, security, DevSecOps, or enterprise platform adoption is helpful, along with experience ramping up quickly in adjacent areas where needed.
  • Experience using AI to scale how your team scopes, documents, and delivers work.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

About the team

The Professional Services team helps customers adopt GitLab in ways that create lasting value. Within that organization, the Technical Architecture team handles some of the most complex and ambiguous work. This includes shaping early delivery approaches for new capabilities, contributing to high-impact customer engagements, and creating the patterns that help the wider organization scale successful services.

You'll manage a growing AMER team of Technical Architects, lead the global Technical Architecture practice, and work closely with Engagement Management, Professional Services Operations, Customer Experience Engineering, and other Professional Services colleagues. We play an important role in setting the technical standard for delivery while also helping define how new services should be scoped, delivered, and improved over time.

GitLab works in an all-remote, asynchronous environment built on transparency, iteration, collaboration, and empowered ownership. In our team, that means giving managers and architects the latitude to solve hard problems, exchange what they learn openly, and continuously improve how the practice runs. If you enjoy developing strong technical talent, creating clarity in fast-changing environments, and helping customers succeed through thoughtful consulting, you'll have a meaningful place to make an impact with us.

This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Headquarters: US Remote

POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Software Engineer in Test to define and own the end-to-end test automation strategy across all products in the Women's Health, Organ Health, and EB (WH/OH/EB) vertical. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend automation suites to validate critical workflows across distributed microservice architectures, guaranteeing data integrity from order entry and lab processing to clinical reporting. You will drive innovation by leveraging AI-assisted practices and large language models to automate test case generation, streamline log analysis, and enhance CI/CD execution speed.

As a Principal level individual contributor, you will set technical direction for quality engineering across multiple teams. You will partner with engineering, bioinformatics, laboratory operations, and Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QA/RA) leaders, and mentor engineers to build quality into the development process instead of inspecting it at the end. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will set technical direction and serve as a key organizational voice across teams. You will leverage strong interpersonal skills, clear communication, and deep technical credibility to align engineering groups, establish architectural standards, and elevate quality practices through peer leadership and technical influence.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, build, and maintain a shared, reusable end-to-end test automation framework covering UI, API, event-driven/messaging, data pipeline, and integration testing across complex distributed systems.
  • Integrate automated testing into the GitLab CI/CD pipelines so that tests run on every change, report clearly, and block releases on regression.
  • Design and stand up ephemeral and persistent test environments, along with service virtualization and mocking for upstream and downstream dependencies.
  • Implement tools and procedures to maintain persistent test environments including, but not limited to, configuration settings, infrastructure updates and removal of deprecated services or tools.
  • Establish test data management practices, including synthetic and de-identified data, version-controlled fixtures, and automated loading of golden datasets into pipelines under test.
  • Partner with bioinformatics scientists and verification and validation teams to automate execution of golden-dataset regression suites against bioinformatics pipelines and to track concordance over time.
  • Ensure automated testing produces objective evidence that satisfies design control and regulatory requirements, including requirements-to-test traceability, verification reports, and audit-ready records.
  • Drive non-functional testing strategy: performance, load, reliability, and security testing in collaboration with platform and security teams.
  • Set coding standards, review practices, and patterns for test code, and evaluate and introduce new tools where they materially improve speed or coverage.
  • Mentor Software Engineers in Test and developers; lead communities of practice and help teams adopt shift-left testing.
  • Analyze defect trends and escaped defects, lead root cause analysis, and drive systemic improvements.
  • Act as the senior technical voice for quality in planning, design reviews, and release decisions.
  • Perform debugging and root cause analysis of product issues or defects.
  • Perform system analysis, assess risk, and develop strong test strategies by analyzing product design and technical specifications, and by collaborating with product managers and developers.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience. 
  • 15+ years of hands-on experience in software development or test automation, with a strong track record of building and scaling test frameworks for enterprise-grade distributed systems..
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and leading adoption of a test automation framework across multiple teams or products, not just contributing to one.
  • Experience testing complex, distributed, multi-service systems end to end, including asynchronous and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP laboratory, medical device, pharma, or similar) is strongly preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Expert-level programming skills in Java and/or Python, and the ability to write production-quality test code.
  • Deep hands-on experience with modern automation tools and libraries, such as Playwright, Selenium, JUnit/TestNG, pytest, REST Assured, and contract testing (for example, Pact).
  • Experience testing Kafka or other messaging systems, REST/gRPC APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Strong CI/CD experience (GitLab CI preferred), plus Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code for test environments.
  • Experience with AWS and cloud-native test environment design.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data integrity across systems.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and command-line scripting.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and Part 820, and computer system validation concepts.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools (for example, Jama, Jira/Xray, TestRail).
  • Exposure to bioinformatics pipelines, LIMS, or genomic data formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) is a plus; no biology background required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain quality risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic judgment about where automation pays off and where it does not.
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, system dependencies, and product integration phases.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.
